question: Across the twelve calendar months of 2025, compute the Pearson correlation between monthly cancellation rate and average Delivered-order delivery time using SQL's CORR() function. Monthly cancellation rate = cancelled orders divided by all orders. Average delivery time = mean of delivery_time_min for Delivered orders with a non-null delivery duration only. Report the correlation coefficient, the number of months used, and whether that correlation alone supports a causal claim.

action.query:
SELECT 
    d.YEAR, d.MONTH, d.MONTH_NAME,
    COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.IS_DELIVERED AND f.DELIVERY_TIME_MIN IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_orders_with_time,
    AVG(CASE WHEN f.IS_DELIVERED AND f.DELIVERY_TIME_MIN IS NOT NULL THEN f.DELIVERY_TIME_MIN ELSE NULL END) AS avg_delivery_time_min,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) > 0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(o.ORDER_ID)::FLOAT ELSE NULL END AS cancellation_rate
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_DATE_FEATURES d
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE o ON o.ORDER_DATE = d.DATE_DAY
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_FULFILLMENT f ON o.ORDER_ID = f.ORDER_ID
WHERE d.YEAR = 2025
GROUP BY d.YEAR, d.MONTH, d.MONTH_NAME
ORDER BY d.MONTH;
action.metrics: monthly cancellation rate, average delivery time (delivered orders with non-null delivery_time_min)
action.reason: First, I need to compute the monthly cancellation rate and average delivery time for each month in 2025 before calculating the Pearson correlation between these two metrics.

action.query:
SELECT CORR(cancellation_rate, avg_delivery_time_min) AS pearson_corr
FROM (
  SELECT 
    d.MONTH,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) > 0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(o.ORDER_ID)::FLOAT ELSE NULL END AS cancellation_rate,
    AVG(CASE WHEN f.IS_DELIVERED AND f.DELIVERY_TIME_MIN IS NOT NULL THEN f.DELIVERY_TIME_MIN ELSE NULL END) AS avg_delivery_time_min
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_DATE_FEATURES d
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE o ON o.ORDER_DATE = d.DATE_DAY
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_FULFILLMENT f ON o.ORDER_ID = f.ORDER_ID
  WHERE d.YEAR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MONTH
) sub;
action.metrics: Pearson correlation between monthly cancellation rate and average delivery time (2025)
action.reason: Now that I have the monthly metrics, I will use SQL's CORR() function to compute the Pearson correlation coefficient between cancellation rate and average delivery time across the 12 months of 2025.

action.metrics: Pearson correlation coefficient, number of months, interpretation of causality
action.answer: The Pearson correlation coefficient between monthly cancellation rate and average delivered-order delivery time across the twelve calendar months of 2025 is -0.020032840302581244. This calculation used all 12 months of 2025. The correlation is very close to zero, indicating almost no linear relationship between the two metrics at the monthly level. Correlation alone does not support a causal claim; it only measures the strength and direction of a linear association. Additional analysis and business context would be required to establish causality.
